terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: SecureLife Express API (PostgreSQL-backed) on port 10000. Required for visitor confirmation emails: RESEND_API_KEY, plus a verified securelifeinsurances.com domain in Resend. Optional: LEAD_CONFIRMATION_FROM (defaults to SecureLife <leads@securelifeinsurances.com>), LEAD_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL, GOOGLE_SHEETS_WEBHOOK_URL + SYNC_SECRET.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Static site server (index.html lead form, dashboard.html) on port 8080.
